title: Tethered EEG Recordings in Syngap1 rats
description: This dataset contains 6-hour tethered EEG recordings from wildtype and Syngap1+/Δ-GAP heterozygous (HET) rats, aged 12-16 weeks, collected to study electrophysiological alterations related to SYNGAP1 haploinsufficiency. Recordings span zeitgeber time 3 to 9 under a 12:12 light:dark cycle, providing a resource for investigating cortical activity abnormalities in a rodent model of SYNGAP1-related intellectual disability and epilepsy.
methods_description: EEG recordings were acquired using an OpenEphys acquisition system with a head-mounted 32-channel EEG array probe (H32-EEG, NeuroNexus, USA) equipped with accelerometers, at a sampling rate of 1 kHz. Each rat underwent one or two 6-hour recording sessions.
